Overview of Gyeonggi Province Region (경기도)

Gyeonggi Province Region (경기도) is located in the Gyeonggi Province region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Suwon. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO), DMZ & Panmunjom (Paju), Korean Folk Village (Yongin), Gapyeong & Nami Island gateway.

RegionGyeonggi Province
Capital citySuwon
Cities & municipalities84
Primary transport hubSuwon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Gyeonggi Province Region

Directly integrated with Seoul Metropolitan Subway, GTX high-speed commuter rail, and KTX via Suwon & Gwangmyeong. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Gyeonggi Province

When visiting cities across Gyeonggi Province, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Suwon Wang Galbi (marinated beef ribs)
  • Icheon rice feast (Hanjeongsik)
  • Uijeongbu Budae-jjigae
  • Paju soybean dishes

Best time to visit Gyeonggi Province

Best time to visit Gyeonggi Province: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
